授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is a basic course of internal combustion engines, including the fundamentals: laws of thermodynamic gas cycle, combustion in engines.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Internal combustion engine, Thermodynamics, Gas cycle, Combustion
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
This course is only offered for third year International Course Students in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering. It is a compulsory course.
